summary.zh-CN: 会话工作区加入与文件预览连续协作的项目文件 Explorer，并增强消息恢复、历史日志读取和启动阶段保护。
summary.en-US: The session workspace gains a project Explorer that stays beside file previews, with stronger message recovery, journal scanning, and startup guards.

body.zh-CN: 目录树和文件预览可以同时显示，连续打开的文件会保留在各自标签页。
body.en-US: The directory tree stays beside the file preview, and files opened in sequence remain in their own tabs.

body.zh-CN: 支持新建、上传、下载、重命名、删除、复制路径，以及把文件或文件夹添加到聊天。
body.en-US: Create, upload, download, rename, delete, copy paths, or add files and folders to the conversation.

body.zh-CN: Explorer 宽度可以拖动并在刷新后保留，空间不足时才使用覆盖式侧栏。
body.en-US: The Explorer width can be resized and persists after refresh, with an overlay reserved for narrow layouts.

body.zh-CN: Native 会话可以并行执行同一轮中的只读文件、图片、网页和记忆查询，写操作和命令仍保持独占。
body.en-US: Native sessions can run read-only file, image, web, and memory queries from the same turn concurrently, while writes and commands remain exclusive.

body.zh-CN: 右键菜单、新建定位和单行面包屑采用熟悉的代码编辑器习惯，文件夹不再出现含义不清的打开操作。
body.en-US: Context menus, create-item reveal, and single-line breadcrumbs follow familiar editor conventions, without an ambiguous Open action on folders.

body.zh-CN: 文件和会话消息中的划选浮层会稳定显示，并与侧栏拖拽等操作正确协作。
body.en-US: Selection controls in files and messages appear reliably and coexist correctly with sidebar resizing.

title.zh-CN: 更稳的消息连接与恢复
title.en-US: More resilient message connection and recovery

body.zh-CN: 空闲 SSE 会主动保活，短暂断流可补齐会话并重连；启动恢复以流式方式读取历史日志。
body.en-US: Idle SSE connections send keepalives, short interruptions can recover and reconnect, and startup recovery streams journal history.

body.zh-CN: NCP 尚未就绪时暂时禁用消息编辑与继续运行，服务恢复后自动重新可用。
body.en-US: Message editing and continuation pause while NCP is unavailable and resume automatically when the service is ready.

title.zh-CN: 项目边界内的安全文件操作
title.en-US: Safe file actions inside the project boundary

body.zh-CN: 所有写操作限制在当前项目根目录内；同名上传默认不覆盖，删除前会再次确认。
body.en-US: All writes stay inside the current project root; uploads do not overwrite by default, and deletion asks for confirmation.

body.zh-CN: 不可靠的 Agent 内 gateway.restart 已移除；需要重启时从外部终端运行顶层 nextclaw restart。
body.en-US: The unreliable in-agent gateway.restart action is removed; use top-level nextclaw restart from an external terminal when needed.
